# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::settings_page`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The settings page frame (`layout.settings-page`, D152): glass with a top-left radius, a 20 px
content host that scrolls, and a restart banner docked below it.

[`Ui::settings_page`](../ui.md#method.Ui.settings_page) draws the glass over the rect it is given (the app's glass layer, whatever the
window's state, with the corner radius of 8 at the top left only: R13, the widget names no
preset), then runs `content` once
in the host: a vertical [`scroll_area`](scroll_area.md) inset [`HOST_PAD`](settings_page.md#constant.HOST_PAD) from the page's
left, top and right, and from the banner (or the page's bottom) below. `content` draws in the
viewport's rect and returns its height. The rows are [`Ui::setting_row`](../ui.md#method.Ui.setting_row); the section nav is the
app's.

The banner is docked at the bottom and shown while [`SettingsPage::restart`](settings_page.md#structfield.SettingsPage.restart) is set: padding 20
by 10 on `status_warning_dark`, a 14 px warning glyph and the message in `status_warning_light`,
and the action button at the right (padding 12 by 6, radius 6, a 1 px `status_warning_light`
border). It fades in with [`REVEAL`](settings_page.md#constant.REVEAL); when the flag is cleared it fades back out and keeps its
space until it is gone, then the content's height snaps. A hidden banner takes no height and
has no node. The action is the app's restart command: [`SettingsResponse::restart`](settings_page.md#structfield.SettingsResponse.restart) is true on
the frame it was pressed (once).

The page is a container, so a disabled page is `with_enabled(false)` around the call, as for
any group; the action then takes no focus and reports nothing. The page moves no focus on its
own: the app knows the first control.
